Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The case of the petitioners is that their land comprising of Chak No. 381 Araji No. 163/3 and 163/4/2 admeasuring 556.2 sq. meters and 0.105 hectares situated in Village-Ramana Naipura,
Pargana Dehat Amanat, District Varanasi was acquired under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The acquisition was for construction of a Sewage Treatment Plant.
Subsequently, on account of change in technology only small portion of the acquired land was used, the remaining land remained unutilized.

Consequently, on representation of various tenure holders whose plots had not been utilized, the respondents had allotted alternative plot to them abutting the boundary Rakesh Kumar Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103458279/
1 wall of theSewage Treatment Plant.
2.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In support of the said contention, learned counsel for the petitioners has invited our attention towards communications sent by Project Manager to Special Land Acquisition (Joint Organisation),
Varanasi on 15.01.2022 and 17.02.2022 and a report dated 30.05.2022.

It is submitted that the petitioners also represented to the authorities for allotment of alternative land to them as their plots have also not been utilized, however, no decision has been taken in the matter so far.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioners for having acquired their aforesaid land or decide the representation dated 27.04.2024 wherein the prayer made is for allotment of alternative plot in lieu of compensation.
3. Sri Hare Ram, learned Standing Counsel and Sri Pranav Mishra, learned counsel for respondent no. 3 have no objection to the same.

4. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of with direction to respondent no. 2 to decide the representation dated 27.04.2024 by a speaking order within eight weeks from the date of communication of the instant order along with photocopy of the representation after receiving a specific report in relation to the prayer of the petitioner from the Project Manager, Ganga Pollution Control Unit-II, U.P. Jal Nigam, (Rural), Varanasi (respondent no. 2).
Order Date :- 14.8.2024

Nitika Sri. (Manish Kumar Nigam, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
